verdicts.reason: A: The SUNSET SALE ribbon crashes into the logo and the first line of the headline. The legal fine print sits between the headline and the body copy, the product can is gone, and the missing-asset placeholder overlaps SMALL BATCH in a cramped bottom row. B: The reading order is scattered. The headline is squeezed into a tall narrow column with many line breaks, the CTA sits at the top before the message, and the SUNSET SALE ribbon and SMALL BATCH badge float on their own in the middle. The can is reduced to a tiny icon. A at least keeps a top-to-bottom order, so it is slightly less bad.
